_about: Operational limits for the gex-only system. Trimmed 2026-07-04: watchlist, alert_throttle, tick, right_eye_gate, and tilt blocks (plus retired model task names) had no readers.

auth._about: Schwab login keep-alive. The refresh token hard-expires 7 days after the interactive login that created it (Schwab policy, no token-only renewal). A daily job checks the token's age and pings the phone to re-auth BEFORE it dies. See the deep-research report.
auth._warn_note: Ping to re-auth once the token is this old — a 1-day buffer before the 7-day wall.
auth._hard_note: Schwab's hard ceiling; the token is dead at/after this age. Do not raise — it just won't work.

ntfy._about: Push channel for alerts + the weekly re-auth ping. A plain HTTPS POST to a public ntfy topic; the topic name is the only secret, so make it long and unguessable. Leave 'topic' empty to log-only (no send). The env var MIRAI_NTFY_TOPIC overrides this value.
ntfy._server_note: Public relay by default; point at a self-hosted ntfy server if you run one.

models._about: Which Claude model each kind of call uses (claude -p --model). Match the model to the difficulty of the job: haiku gathers, sonnet drafts and argues, opus decides. Opus is reserved for calls whose output directly moves a thesis or a bet's stance; everything that merely collects, trims, drafts, or argues a side runs cheaper. claude_cli.call(task=...) resolves through this map; an explicit model= override always wins.
models._default_note: Unknown task names resolve here - middle tier, never silently opus.
models._watchtower_note: HEAD B, the reasoning head - PINNED exact id (never an alias): a silently re-pointed alias would change the judge mid-record. Model bump = record reset, same as a prompt bump.

macro_mood._about: BETA Morning Macro-Mood layer (intraday/macro_mood.py). Each morning the analyst writes a market-wide direction/magnitude expectation (state/market_expectation/); the tick loop reads it as a light reasoning-context tilt (never gates/sizes) and re-dives the analyst when price breaches a gamma wall. Shadow: it learns its own reliability, which scales the tilt. Inert until an analyzer provider is wired.
macro_mood._wall_buffer_note: A re-dive fires only when spot pushes past a gamma wall by this fraction of the implied daily move - filters ordinary in-wall pullbacks.
macro_mood._redive_cap_note: Max analyst re-dives per day (opus budget guard).
macro_mood._redive_cooldown_note: Min minutes between re-dives for the same ticker+wall, so a price riding a level can't spam calls.
